user.title: Set up Sonoff ZHA
user.description: Click Submit to enable the Sonoff ZHA integration. It registers the bundled ZHA custom quirks for SONOFF Zigbee devices (currently the SWV-ZF2 dual-channel water valve). There is nothing to configure here. A Home Assistant restart may be required for the quirks to apply to already-joined devices, followed by a Reconfigure on the device.

abort.already_configured: Sonoff ZHA is already set up.

irrigation_by_liters.name: Liters🪣💧 (🌱volume irrigation)
irrigation_by_liters.description: Volume: opens the chosen line of the SONOFF SWV-ZF2 valve; the valve closes it by itself once the target liters have been delivered.

channel.name: Line
channel.description: Which of the two valve lines to open (A or B, as printed on the device).

liters.name: Liters
liters.description: Target volume to deliver, in liters.

fail_safe_minutes.name: Fail-safe timeout
fail_safe_minutes.description: Maximum time the line may stay open, in minutes (0 disables the fail-safe). If not set, the valve keeps its current fail-safe setting.

irrigation_by_minutes.name: Minutes⏰💧 (🌱timed irrigation)
irrigation_by_minutes.description: Time: opens the chosen line of the SONOFF SWV-ZF2 valve; the valve closes it by itself when the set minutes are up.

channel.name: Line
channel.description: Which of the two valve lines to open (A or B, as printed on the device).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to irrigate, in minutes.

fail_safe_minutes.name: Fail-safe timeout
fail_safe_minutes.description: Maximum time the line may stay open, in minutes (0 disables the fail-safe). If not set, the valve keeps its current fail-safe setting.

set_irrigation_plan.name: Plan📅 save a schedule on the valve
set_irrigation_plan.description: Writes one of the valve's 6 on-device plans for a line. The valve then waters by itself, even with Home Assistant down.

channel.name: Line
channel.description: Which of the two valve lines the plan waters (A or B, as printed on the device).

index.name: Plan slot
index.description: Which of the line's 6 plan slots (0-5) to write. Writing a used slot replaces its plan.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off keeps the plan stored on the valve without running it.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days to run on, when Repeat is 'On chosen weekdays'.

interval_days.name: Every N days
interval_days.description: Days between runs (1-30), when Repeat is 'Every N days'; counted from the day the plan is first saved.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Local time the valve opens the line.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Run length in minutes. Give either minutes or liters.

liters.name: Liters
liters.description: Volume to deliver. Give either minutes or liters.

fail_safe_minutes.name: Fail-safe timeout
fail_safe_minutes.description: For a liters plan: longest time the line may stay open, in minutes.

remove_irrigation_plan.name: Delete📅 a plan from the valve
remove_irrigation_plan.description: Removes one of a line's on-device plans from the valve and from Home Assistant.

channel.name: Line
channel.description: Which of the two valve lines (A or B, as printed on the device).

index.name: Plan slot
index.description: Which of the line's 6 plan slots (0-5) to remove.

rain_delay.name: Rain delay☔ skip the plans
rain_delay.description: Suspends all of the valve's plans for the given hours; 0 cancels a running delay.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long to skip the plans, in hours (0 cancels).

resync_plans.name: Resync🔄 the valve's plans
resync_plans.description: Rewrites all 6 plan slots of both lines so the valve matches Home Assistant.

set_program.name: Program🔁 zones back to back
set_program.description: Stores a daily program: zones run one after another from a start time. Home Assistant keeps the valves' plans in step whenever a setting changes.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Time the first zone starts. Give this or a start time helper.

start_entity.name: Start time helper
start_entity.description: An input_datetime holding the start time; changing it rewrites the plans.

gap_minutes.name: Gap
gap_minutes.description: Minutes between one zone ending and the next starting.

slot.name: Plan slot
slot.description: The plan slot (0-5) the program uses on every line it waters.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Ordered list of zones: each has a line switch, minutes or a minutes helper, and optionally enabled or an on/off helper.

manual_cap_minutes.name: Manual cap
manual_cap_minutes.description: Minutes the valve allows any run started without its own length (button, plain switch on, Home Assistant down). Restored on each program valve after every run.

manual_cap_entity.name: Manual cap helper
manual_cap_entity.description: An input_number holding the manual cap in minutes; changing it rewrites the valves' manual default.

clear_program.name: Forget🔁 the stored program
clear_program.description: Stops keeping the plans in step with the program settings. The plans stay on the valves.
